lina (devex): heads-up — CI flake: node sampleapp failing intermittently on embeddings -> rerank with vector-length errors and occasional `items: null`.
omar (sdk): can you paste the failing log?
harry (sampleapp): gist from CI:
Error: InvalidArgument: expected embeddings[0].length == 1536, got 1535
 at Batcher.process (/app/src/batcher.ts:88)
 at sendEmbeddings (/app/src/client.ts:120)
Caused by: rerank body contains `items: null`
marta (eng-ml): pattern I've seen: batching helper mutates a shared buffer when a retry (after auth refresh) re-enqueues the same batch — timing-dependent pad/truncate.
omar (sdk): OK — immediate plan: 1) make batcher copy buffers on enqueue so retries don't mutate originals, 2) add verifyVectors(vecs, expectedDim) in SDK to fail fast, 3) make rerank response validation strict and return clear 400 if `items` is not an array of numbers.
lina (devex): can we also surface a dev-mode env var to catch these early (e.g. REDWOOD_VEC_STRICT=1)? add note to onboarding.
harry (sampleapp): temporary mitigation: added assert in consumer: `if (v.length !== MODEL_DIMS) throw new Error('vec dim mismatch')` and updated README.
ci-bot: queued: run sampleapp smoke with REDWOOD_VEC_STRICT=1
omar (sdk): preparing v0.9.4-canary with immutability change + unit test simulating concurrent token refresh + pad path. will add small e2e to mock 401 mid-flow and assert final rerank request shape.
marta (eng-ml): also adding an integration check that rerank `items` is a numeric array to CI smoke.
lina (devex): thanks — keeping thread for PR links and postmortem notes.
